verdict.rationale: The evidence suggests this is possible but never shows it directly. Solid is described as web-component friendly and able to author custom elements (solid-gh-7), which could be embedded in an existing server-rendered page. It also gives direct DOM access and works alongside native JS libraries (solid-gh-8). Its SSR and progressive hydration (solid-gh-4) concern Solid's own server rendering, not pages rendered by other back ends. Missing for 10: explicit docs on mounting components into elements of an existing non-Solid HTML page, a no-build or script-tag setup, guidance on islands or incremental adoption, and hands-on corroboration.
